pages.en:
VORETSCH (Dr.)
Description: German, formerly Consul at Hongkong, 45 years old,
medium height and build, reddish hair.
German secret service. Nielsen and Lemmbler said to be his
assistants. Ettinger, Rufio, and Josephi used to make their
reports to him. See File No. 898.
Watched from 11:12:16 to 10:1:17. See File No. 787.
pages.zh:
VORETSCH（博士）
描述：德国人，前香港领事，45岁，中等身材和体格，红发。
德国秘密情报机构。Nielsen 和 Lemmbler 据称为其助手。Ettinger、Rufio 和 Josephi 曾向他汇报。见档案第 898 号。
监视时间从 16年12月11日至 17年1月10日。见档案第 787 号。

POLICE FORCE,

CONFIDENTIAL.

Sir,

In connection with the German Secret Service
it is reported that Ettinger, Rufio and Josephi
have been in the habit of making their reports
to two persons bearing the names of Schaller
and Schlesien who occupied an office in the
Neue Abtheilung in the German Consulate.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：D.S.P.
For inform: of Bureau.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

February 6th 1917

Sir,
Dr.E.Voretzsch, the former German Consul at
Hongkong, is reported to be the Chief of the German
Secret Service in Shanghai. He resides at the
German Club from whence he goes daily to the
German Consulate. He receives correspondence
addressed to him C/O Nielsen No.109 Chaotung Road.
Nielsen is one of his assistants. Another
is an employee of the Consulate who bears the name
of Lemmbler and who speaks Russian having previously
served in the Consular service at Vladivostock.
Their activities, as far as can be gathered
from reports received, have been directed to
Eastern Siberia, particularly Vladivostock and
numbers of Russian speaking men and women who
incidentally do a big trade in smuggling opium
are said to travel from Shanghai in that direction
in their interests.
Voretzsch, after he left Hongkong, travelled
for sometime in company with a Chinese in the
southern part of China ere he appeared at Shanghai.
He is about 45 years of age, of medium build; has
reddish hair and is at present wearing a moustache
which makes his appearance look very different
from that of the photograph.
There are certain Chinese who are alleged to
work for German interests in Shanghai , amongst
whom may be mentioned:-
Yang Tcheng 楊晟 Special Envoy for Foreign Affairs.
Yu Ya Ching 虞洽卿 comprador of the Netherlands
Trading Society.
Kwan Ts Ching 關子卿 comprador of Siemens China Co,
1 A Jinkee Road.-
Wang Tcheng, the Special Envoy for Foreign Affairs
has a weakness for advertising himself in the
Chinese newspapers. Whenever there is any talk of his
being removed from Shanghai he contrives to get a
paragraph inserted containing the rumour of his

警务处，

1917年2月6日

先生，
前德国驻香港领事 E. Voretzsch 博士，据报为上海德国秘密情报机构负责人。他居住在德国总会，每日由此前往德国领事馆。他接收寄给他的信件，地址为：赵通路109号 Nielsen 转。Nielsen 是其助手之一。另一名助手是领事馆雇员，名为 Lemmbler，会说俄语，此前曾在符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的领事部门任职。
根据收到的报告，他们的活动方向似乎是西伯利亚东部，特别是符拉迪沃斯托克；据说有许多讲俄语的男女，顺便从事大量鸦片走私贸易，正为了他们的利益从上海前往该方向。
Voretzsch 离开香港后，在抵达上海之前，曾与一名中国人在中国南部旅行了段时间。他约45岁，中等身材；红发，目前留着胡须，使其外貌与照片大相径庭。
据称有一些中国人在上海为德国利益工作，其中包括：
Yang Tcheng 楊晟 外交特派员。
Yu Ya Ching 虞洽卿 荷兰贸易公司买办。
Kwan Ts Ching 關子卿 西门子中国公司买办，
南京路1A号。-
外交特派员 Wang Tcheng（王正廷/杨晟? 原文此处拼写与前文 Yang Tcheng 不同，但职位相同，暂按原文保留拼音，结合上下文及历史人物，此处应指杨晟，但原文写作 Wang Tcheng，依规则保留原文或注明，鉴于前文已出现 Yang Tcheng 楊晟，此处可能是笔误或另一人，但职位描述完全一致，故保留原文拼音并参照前文译名逻辑，若不确定则保留。注：历史上杨晟曾任外交特派员。此处原文写 Wang Tcheng，但中文未给，故保留拼音）有一个在中文报纸上自我宣传的癖好。每当有关于他被调离上海的传闻时，他总会设法刊登一段包含该调职谣言的文字，

transfer and has a contradiction arranged and published
on the same style generally on the day following.
In this connection the following translation of
an extract from the Sin Wan Pao of January 17th
1917 is interesting:-
"Mr. Yang Toheng the Special Envoy for
Foreign Affairs, will entertain the German,
Austrian, American, Swedish, Norwegian Consuls,
the manager of Deutsche Asiatic Bank , and other
prominent German and Austrian merchants to tiffin
in the Bureau of Foreign Affairs at 12.30 p.m.
19th inst. Yu Ya Ching 虞洽卿 Wu Wei Kiu 吳懷玖
(the former City Magistrate) and Chang Su Ho 張叔和
will also be requested to join the tiffin party."
None of the Daily Chinese papers published
and translated in this office show themselves
at present openly pro-German but a weekly
paper which bears the name of Hsieh Ho Pao 協和報
and which is issued from an office at 33 Nanking
Road gives to China the German version of the origin
and progress of the War. The Editor's name is
given as Finke but the work is done entirely
by Chinese. This paper has an agency in Peking in 德華電報社
the office of the German Telegraph Coy. Its price
is fifteen cents per copy and it is reported
to have a large circulation.
There appear to be a great many Chinese
in the German Consulate who are engaged in
translation and clerical work but we do not know
whether this is for the Hsieh Ho Pao 協和報 or on
account of other papers destined for circulation
in other provinces of this country.
Dr.Pernitzsch has made more than one tour
amongst the Chinese since the War broke out for
the object, it is stated, of furthering German commercial
and other interests in certain parts of China.

D.S.C.
K.W.
21/7. AM

Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

并在次日通常以同样的方式安排刊登辟谣声明。
就此而言，以下翻译自1917年1月17日《新闻报》的一段摘录颇有趣味：
“外交特派员 Yang Toheng（杨晟）先生，将于本月19日中午12时30分，在外交公署宴请德国、奥地利、美国、瑞典、挪威领事，德华银行经理以及其他著名的德奥商人共进午餐。虞洽卿 Yu Ya Ching、吴怀玖 Wu Wei Kiu（前上海县知事）和张叔和 Chang Su Ho 也将受邀参加午餐会。”
本处出版和翻译的中文日报中，目前没有一家公开表现出亲德立场，但有一份名为《协和报》 Hsieh Ho Pao 的周刊，从南京路33号的办公室发行，向中国提供关于战争起源和进展的德国版本说法。编辑名字列为 Finke，但工作完全由中国人完成。该报在北京设有代理处，位于德华电报社，即德国电报公司办公室。每份售价十五分，据报道发行量很大。
德国领事馆内似乎有很多中国人从事翻译和文书工作，但我们不知道这是为了《协和报》 Hsieh Ho Pao，还是为了其他旨在在中国其他省份发行的报纸。
自战争爆发以来，Pernitzsch 博士已多次在中国人中进行巡视，据称目的是促进德国在中国某些地区的商业和其他利益。

D.S.C.
K.W.
7月21日. 上午
1917年3月15日-

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
首席探长。

警察总监。

FILED
31st January, 1917.
REPORT ON Dr. Voretzsch, German Secret Service.
Made by D.S.Givens. Forwarded by
Sir,
I beg to report that Dr. Voretzsch, who is said to be the
head of the German secret service in Shanghai, was formerly
a Consul in Hongkong. He is about 45 years old and of medium
height and build. He has red hair, a red Kaiser moustache,
and pale features. He resides in the German Club, and goes
daily to the German Consulate. Some of his letters are
addressed: C/o Nielsen, No. 109 Chaotung Road.
Attached please find his photo.
One of his assistants is a man named
Lemmeler who speaks Russian & who is
an employee of the German Consulate
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.S.Givens
Detective Sergeant.
Chief Detective Inspector.

谨报告称，据称为上海德国秘密情报机构负责人的 Voretzsch 博士，前为香港领事。他约45岁，中等身高和体格。他有红头发，红色的凯撒式胡须，面色苍白。他居住在德国总会，每日前往德国领事馆。他的一些信件地址为：赵通路109号 Nielsen 转。
